call_points.text: FY27 volume growth guided at mid-single digits
₹275 Cr capex planned for FY27, 65-70% funded by internal accruals
Demand holding up well despite July rains, project sales to increase by 3-4%
No corporate guarantee on JV loan, balance sheet not under pressure
New 9+ million sqm greenfield plant in South with ₹350 Cr potential revenue
Tile volumes guided to decent single-digit growth; sanitaryware and adhesives to healthy double digits.
Company running at 100% capacity across the country, excluding non-value-added kilns.
No buyback possible for 6-8 months due to SEBI embargo during subsidiary consolidation; promoters bought stock before the trading window shut.
Demand is weak now; if it does not return strongly in June, Morbi will be in trouble and a couple of Somany plants may shut on stock.
New Labour Code one-time INR5 Cr adjustment taken; transport inflation not yet quantified.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth of 20% to 25% expected in FY27 if prices remain at current levels
EBITDA margin improvement of at least 150 bps from the 9.3% FY26 base
Tile volume growth in decent single digits; sanitaryware and adhesives in healthy double digits
guidance.target: single digit tiles, double digit sanitaryware/adhesives

operating_notes.text: Completion of disinvestment in Acer Granito Private Limited extended by 9 months from 4th May 2026 with applicable interest.
Scheme of amalgamation involves merging wholly-owned subsidiaries Somany Bathware, Somany Excel Vitrified, and SR Continental into Somany Ceramics with an appointed date of April 1, 2025.
Morbi gas price for May 2026 is about INR74 plus 6% tax; North plant about INR4-INR5 cheaper; South at INR78 per SCM with a long-term contract from next month expected at least INR17-INR18 cheaper.
Total input cost increase about INR7 per sq ft (gas INR5.5-6, other INR1-1.5); tile prices raised 16%-17% since March, sanitaryware/bathware blended 8% in April.
FY26 sales volume was 72 million square meters; outsourced sales about 35%-36% of volume including Acer and Amora.
Capacity utilization increased to 83% from 72% YoY
JVs swung to ₹3 Cr profit from ₹10 Cr loss YoY
Working capital days reduced from 17 to 12 days

timeline.summary: Somany Ceramics extended the timeline to complete the sale of its stake in associate Acer Granito by 9 months from 4 May 2026.
Somany Ceramics Limited’s Board of Directors, led by **Anuj Kalia**, declared an interim dividend of ₹4.00 per equity share (200% of face value) on May 4, 2026, payable by May 8, 2026.
Somany Ceramics scheduled a court-convened meeting of shareholders for June 13, 2026, to approve the amalgamation of three wholly-owned subsidiaries.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹817.93 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹37.82 Cr.
Anuj Kalia, Director of Somany Ceramics Limited, shared the Q4 FY2025-26 earnings call recording on 15 May 2026 via provided link.
On May 18, 2026, Somany Ceramics issued a revised Q4 FY26 investor presentation correcting standalone working capital days to -4.
Somany Ceramics held its Q4 FY26 earnings call on May 15, 2026, guiding for 20-25% revenue growth in FY27.

On 21 May 2026, Somany Ceramics said it received an NCLT Kolkata corrigendum order dated 24 April 2026 correcting the 9 April 2026 first-motion order on the amalgamation of Somany Bathware, Somany Excel Vitrified and SR Continental into it, with shareholder and unsecured creditor meetings set for 13 June 2026.
On June 1, 2026, Somany Ceramics issued a corrigendum to the notice of the court-convened meeting of equity shareholders for the amalgamation scheme.
Somany Ceramics held Q1FY27 earnings call on August 12, 2026, reporting 11.5% EBITDA margin and announcing a new greenfield plant.

watchlist.response: Evasive on the number: "I don't have it at the back of my hand as to what, but as a percentage, our outsourced sales is 30%... about 35%, 36%."
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for outsourced (traded) sales volume guidance for FY28; management said it did not have the figure at hand and gave only a 35%-36% share.

watchlist.response: Gave FY26 vs FY25 averages instead and called current pricing "extremely volatile".
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for North, South and West gas prices for Q4 and current; management declined to give Q4 split, saying Q4 was flat except the last 15 days of March.
Approval of equity shareholders and unsecured creditors of Somany Ceramics at the 13 June 2026 meetings

watchlist.response: Management clarified margin expansion is structural due to operational efficiencies, not pricing, which was only pass-through
watchlist.text: Analyst questioned the sustainability of margins given Morbi's return and potential price cuts
